moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-tracking-in-expand, written here): Whole line: letter-spacing −0.5 em → 0 (chars start piled at the centre and spread outward), opacity 0 → 1 (full by 70 %), 0.7 s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1) (easeOutCubic), from 0.3 s. Layout-free version: char x = (i − (n−1)/2) × −0.5 em → 0. Loop exit: fade 2.65–2.95 s; loop 3 s. Params: from: giãn chữ đầu (−0.5 em) · duration (0.7 s) · ease (easeOutCubic). Layout-free: each letter moves by (i − centre) × tracking instead of changing letter-spacing, so nothing reflows.
